title: The big city in mall world, just without the freeways ( I couldnt get the AI to generate it correctly)
content: Notice the old town vibes on the outside of the city. The city gets progressively more advanced the deeper you get. Has anyone else experienced their city like this? Also freeway world goes everywhere throughout the city. I just couldnt get the ai to generate it properly but just imagine this with the freeways and stuff. Also there should be more people on the streets.
